answer: When an AI agent joins the market it must present a cryptographic proof of stake that is issued by a trusted marble‑clad node at the network summit, and that node records the agent’s public key in a hollow ledger entry that can only be extended by a signed referral. Each referral reward is paid only if the new agent’s stake originates from a distinct previous stake, so a recruiter receives zero tokens for any recruit that links back to its own identity.
